## Notable fixes

- An open file that is deleted or renamed outside Lattice no longer becomes a tab that never saves: the tab follows a renamed file, closes when nothing is unsaved, or keeps your edits and offers to recreate or save them elsewhere. Restoring an older version of the file now reloads it.
- ⌘Z in the source editor undoes only your own typing, not an Overleaf collaborator's or the agent's edits.
- A project's or your own `.latexmkrc` can no longer move the PDF out of the preview or keep a build from finishing.
- `\input` and `\include` paths now resolve from the root document's folder, so a root in a subfolder finds its files.
- Building a `standalone` figure or a `subfiles` chapter compiles it once and no longer makes it the project's main document.
- A `.bib` file linked from outside the project, such as a Zotero export, now works with citations, search and replace.
- Enter and Escape in the symbol palette, find and replace, and file rename are left to your input method while it is composing.
- Settings stay in sync across open windows, and the "Your name" setting keeps the spaces you type.
- A hidden agent panel no longer keeps Claude running or warms up new chats.
- Claude in the agent panel can now pick Lattice's enabled bundled skills, such as making slides, on its own.
- The remaining error messages from the app now show in Chinese in the Chinese interface.
- The PDF viewer is updated to pdf.js 6.5.438.
